title: Recipe index
description: Everything in the recipes repo, parsed and resolved: what `recipes build` writes to index.json, what the site renders, and what the skill reads when it has no repo. Display strings (amount, line, text) are ready to show as-is; the structured fields beside them are for scaling, linking, and highlighting.

schema.description: Format version. It changes only when a field is removed or changes meaning; new fields keep the number.

commit.description: The git commit this index was built from, when known.

recipes.description: Every recipe and drink, sorted by slug.

plans.description: Every plan, sorted by id (so by start date).

vocab.description: The ingredient dictionary, sections in store order.

units.description: Every canonical unit an amount can name, for showing scaled amounts.

plural.description: The unit's name for more than one, like cups; null when it doesn't change, like tsp.

metric.description: Metric amounts read as decimals; the rest read as kitchen fractions like 1 1/2.

recipe.description: One .cook file. Frontmatter fields appear only when set.

slug.description: The file name without .cook; the recipe's id and URL segment.

path.description: The file's path in the repo, like recipes/pork-carnitas.cook.

course.description: Where it fits in a meal.

cuisine.description: Lowercase cuisine, like mexican or southeast-asian.

servings.description: How many it serves as written; amounts scale from this.

time_total.description: Minutes from start to plate, including passive time. Absent only for drinks.

leftovers.description: How well it keeps: great means as good or better the next day.

tags.description: Lowercase labels like weeknight or freezer-friendly.

rating.description: Our rating, 1 to 5, once we've made it.

source.description: Where it came from: a URL, or text like "Grandma".

description.description: One sentence for the index page.

pairs.description: Slugs of dishes that go with it, both ways: the recipe's own list, then the recipes that list it.

proteins.description: Proteins from its non-optional ingredients, per the vocab; empty means none.

ingredients.description: Ingredient lists, one per section that has ingredients.

cookware.description: Equipment named in the steps, in order of first use.

sections.description: The method: steps and notes, grouped by section.

last_cooked.description: The latest cooked date across all plans, or null if never.

times_cooked.description: How many times plans record it as cooked.

ingredientGroup.description: The ingredients of one section, with repeat mentions combined.

section.description: The section's heading, or null for the unnamed first section.

items.description: Ingredients in order of first use.

name.description: The vocab name, like scallion; null if it isn't in the vocab (only possible in a draft).

text.description: The name as the recipe writes it, like green onions.

optional.description: Marked optional with @?, such as a garnish.

note.description: Prep or substitution notes, joined with "; " when mentioned more than once.

amount.description: The total amount for display, like "1 1/2 cups"; empty when none is given.

amounts.description: The same total, structured for scaling. Several parts when units can't be combined, like a weight and a volume.

line.description: The whole ingredient line, ready to show: "1.5 kg pork shoulder (cut into chunks)".

amount.description: A quantity and unit. Exactly one of value or text is present unless only a unit was written.

value.description: A number; multiply by (wanted servings / servings) to scale.

text.description: A quantity that isn't a number, like "2-3" or "a pinch"; doesn't scale.

unit.description: Canonical unit (tsp, cup, g, clove...), or the written unit if unknown, or null for a count.

fixed.description: Present and true when the amount must not scale.

section.description: A run of steps and notes under one heading.

name.description: The heading, or null for the unnamed first section.

text.description: The step's prose, ready to show.

tokens.description: The same prose split into pieces, for highlighting ingredients, equipment, and timers. Joining their display text gives text.

note.description: A tip or aside written with >.

token.description: A piece of a step. Its display text is value for text, amount for a timer, and text otherwise.

text.description: The name as written in the step.

name.description: The vocab name, or null if unknown.

amount.description: This mention's amount for display; empty when none.

text.description: The timer's name, if it has one.

amount.description: The duration for display, like "8 minutes".

plan.description: One plans/*.md file: a week, or a one-off like a dinner party.

id.description: The file name without .md, like 2026-10-12 or 2026-12-24-christmas-eve.

path.description: The file's path in the repo.

start.description: The first day, from the file name.

name.description: The name part of a one-off plan's id, or null for a week.

spent.description: What the shopping cost, if recorded.

extras.description: Other things to buy, placed by the vocab when they match.

meals.description: What's planned and what was cooked.

servings.description: Servings to make, if not the recipe's own.

cooked.description: When it was made; absent until then.

name.description: The section, like produce or pantry.

staple.description: Always stocked (pantry, bar), so left off shopping lists.

aka.description: Other names that mean this entry.

protein.description: The protein it counts as, like pork.
